property_summary: For any caller address and any deposit amount, calling addToBalance twice in sequence (two separate transactions) always results in the contract's recorded balance for that caller equaling the sum of the two deposits in the correct contract; the mutant's inverted lock can cause the second call to be blocked/skipped so the recorded balance is not the sum.
change_summary: Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to set locked_ = false before execution and true after, inverting the lock logic which can alter whether addToBalance executes and thus the observed balance.
